topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the learning outcomes concerning cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cancer initiates and progresses through Darwinian selection acting on genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations.

topics.label: Stem cell hierarchy and cell of origin in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how stem cell properties, tissue hierarchies, and specific cells of origin determine tumor initiation and propagation.

topics.label: Role of the microenvironment, inflammation, and stroma in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate how inflammatory stimuli, environmental promoters, and supportive stromal interactions facilitate the outgrowth of incipient and established tumors.

topics.label: Experimental and computational methods for studying tumor evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the sequencing, modeling, and spatial profiling technologies used to track tumor evolution and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Synthesis of evolutionary forces in cancer progression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic integrates mutational events, transcriptional states, cell-of-origin features, and microenvironmental factors into a unified evolutionary model of malignancy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and next session preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and introduces the topic for the subsequent session.
